findings.note: C1 (PR #1969 copy round 1). Draft 'Appli inconnue' used 'Appli', which appears in no other fr value; the fr catalogue renders 'app' as 'application' in 235 values (e.g. ui.console.unavailable.title, ui.chat.canonical.link_actions.open_in_default_app). Corrected in the audited bytes to 'Application inconnue' (feminine agreement kept). Disposition: fixed. The correction is the catalogue's established term, authored by this auditor; disclosed, not hidden.

'Appli' kept for the badge: the context asks for one short word for a small badge, and 'Appli' is the standard French short form; 'Application' would roughly double the badge width beside the name. Rendered beside 'Application inconnue' when the name is missing, which reads as abbreviation + full form, not as two terms.

'Expéditeur inconnu' is byte-identical to the already-audited fr ui.ownerAudit.unknown_sender (same English 'Unknown sender'), so the channel and the owner audit name this state the same way. Sentence case, no Title Case (fr guide).

Mechanical checks on the audited bytes: key set equals English ui.teamBridge.json; the three values carry no placeholders/ICU (English has none), no leading/trailing or double spaces, no bidi control characters anywhere in the file, all NFC. The base-to-head diff of this file is exactly these 3 added lines (git diff 58cbcea2..f731886a: 3 insertions, 0 deletions); every other value is the previously audited bytes.
